profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Nationwide Insurance

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
*  With minimal guidance, develops cost-effective information technology solutions by creating new or modifying existing software applications that are moderately complex.

* Analyzes and validates moderately complex system requirements and existing business processes and information systems.  Develops and implements new programs and/or modifications of existing applications.  Responsible for the design, prototyping and other methodologies for new and/or existing systems including the development of test plans and program specifications with minimal interfaces.

* Codes, tests, debugs, documents, and implements moderately complex software applications according to standards.  

*  Assisted in redesign of cloud native platform architecture via programming template infrastructure solutions for use in harness.io and kubernetes with rancher.

* Develops specifications and programs moderately complex technical modules, applications, prototypes and computer programs.

* Performs all aspects of applications programming and development including file design, update, storage and retrieval.

* Evaluates and provides technical solutions to moderately complex application development problems.

* Performs other duties as assigned.

positions.title: Application Services Engineer
positions.description:
* Contract through KForce to support Third Party applications that is used by Scottsdale Insurance; Box, Ausum, AIR, and SFTP.
* Providing support and maintenance of the Application Production and Test Environments.
* Executes the service transition process for transitioning Applications into the Production environment and insure support structures are in place.
* Install software remotely for agencies using GoToAssist as well as supporting SFTP users with configuration issues.
* Document all troubleshooting with uploading issues for both the BOX.com application and SFTP.
* Used both ticketing system HEAT application and Service Center.

positions.title: CRM Admin
positions.description:
* Support all current Microsoft Dynamics CRM requirements and development efforts within the CAH network.

* Assisted with upgrade and integration from Dynamics 2011 to 2013

* Re-engineered the existing configuration

* Assisted with Incident Tickets during conversion phase to ensure system stability

* Provided input for system architectures changes

* Worked on my own and with the CRM developers to investigate and solve system-wide technical problems, and support efforts to develop new features.

* Provided as-needed assistance with the administration of other applications in the CAH Environment

* Communicate effectively with the developer and the project management team to understand and document new requirements as well as communicate level of effort and schedule.

positions.title: Client Technologies Tech I
positions.description:
* Assess and fulfill user/department needs and request for hardware and software. Evaluate and recommend alternative solutions where appropriate in a timely manner.

* Document and address resolution of all customer request, problems, and inquiries in a timely manner whether by email, telephone, and help desk call queue or in person.

* Perform effective and efficient diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution for end-user hardware and software issues.

* Provide excellent customer service by seeking to understand and addressing customer needs and expectations through effective communication and collaboration.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description:
* Manage disk backups on the server on a daily basis.

* Desktop, laptop, and PDA support for users in office and remote users.

* Involved in changing the company’s email signature.

* Re-image desktop and laptops using Ghost software and troubleshoot both Windows XP and 7 desktop and laptop issues.

* Install and provide support for CRM software.

* Manage Avaya system to add phone numbers, edit voice mail, and run reports.

* Manage clients on our secure FTP site.

positions.title: Desktop Support Analyst
positions.description:
* Provided desktop support for users issue dealing with Microsoft Office, Internet Explorer, Adobe, as well as any hardware issue with monitors, desktop, and laptops.

* Provided Basic LAN/WAN support and troubleshooting.

* Provided telecomm support, including IP phones.

* Participate in the planning and implementation of operating system and application software installation and upgrades.

* Re-image computers and laptops using Casper program.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
* Resolve technical information and provide solutions via multiple mediums of communication to internal and external customers. Troubleshoot issues for PC, Mac, and laptops users and also assist with project roll-out.

* Knowledge and experience in the use of Microsoft Active Directory, Symantec PCAnywhere, LANDesk Management, VNC, and Remote Desktop. Also experience in the use of ticketing operating systems such as Magic& Infra to manage workflow.

* Support Kaplan’s proprietary products and new product roll-outs assist in the daily support of all locations nationwide; and monitor Kaplan’s automated process and nightly backups.

* Assist users at their location with computers, printers, and scanner issues. As well as assisting with moves and installations.

* Re-image computers using either PXE boot or Ghost imaging. Examples of issues I have helped resolve range from power supply and hard drive replacements to virus clean up, back up and recover.

positions.title: Telecom Analyst
positions.description:
Coordinated Telecom installs for various Kaplan locations within the US. 
Supervised employees in handling routine telecom issues they might have with bills or services.
Troubleshoot wireless issues users had with their cell phones, pagers, blackberries, and wireless air cards.
Implemented consolidating billing for our telecom bills in order to get better rates from our vendors.
Started an online billing process in order to save money on paper bills being charged.
